brand_voice.personality_notes: Community-first, welcoming to anxious and underserved patients. Language is casual and conversational ('Don't worry if we're not in your network', 'Fearful patients welcome too!'). Genuine warmth shows in testimonials — staff remembered by first name, patients feel like family. The practice punches far above its website's visual impression.

scout_summary: 6 to 9 Dental is a genuinely strong practice hiding behind a catastrophically outdated website. Dr. Humphrey has won America's Best Dentist six consecutive years (2021–2026), the practice has 15+ enthusiastic patient reviews, and offers rare differentiators (walk-in evenings/weekends, massage chairs, sliding-scale pricing, mercury-free). But the website tells none of this story effectively. The homepage greets visitors with unedited Wix placeholder text ('Write your caption here'), no headline, no hero image, and a broken contact form. The teal color palette is the one salvageable design asset. Everything else needs to be rebuilt from scratch around the practice's three core strengths: accessibility (walk-in/emergency/evening-weekend), affordability (sliding scale/PPO), and authority (Dr. Humphrey's award-winning credentials). The redesign should target South San Antonio families who are price-sensitive, schedule-constrained, or dental-anxious — and show them immediately that this practice was built for them.
